content.text: This market will resolve to "Yes" if Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is awarded the 2025–26 regular season NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) Award. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". If the listed player is not announced as a finalist for the 2025–26 NBA MVP award, this market will immediately resolve to "No". However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's overwhelming 97.2% implied probability in the NBA MVP market reflects the Oklahoma City Thunder's league-best 64-18 record, where he served as the clear best player, averaging 31.1 points, 6.6 assists, and 1.4 steals on historic 55.3% field-goal shooting in 68 games to clear the 65-game eligibility threshold. Recent finalist announcements on April 19 named him alongside Nikola Jokic and Victor Wembanyama, but trader consensus solidified behind Shai after OKC clinched the No. 1 Western Conference seed, capping his efficient, low-turnover dominance amid a tight late-season race.
